title: Phase 55F promotes seven bounded records and holds one company claim
summary: FTFN promoted seven specific records covering data-centre electricity pressure, federal crash reporting, semiconductor materials research, Artemis hardware integration, plant-breeding awards, Canadian building-permit intentions, and storage-manufacturing funding. The Joby certification-test record remains In Review because the selected milestone is still an interested-party claim without an FAA record independently confirming it.
evidence_note: Each promoted record preserves its conversion boundary: aggregate electricity growth is not a local capacity forecast; crash reports are not normalized safety rankings; funding is not a result; hardware integration is not launch readiness; awards are not field performance; permits are not housing delivery; and a prize is not manufacturing or deployment. The held Joby record still lacks independent confirmation of the company-described certification milestone.
